_comment: desktop_only / mobile_only / missing_from_cli: name -> why the difference is deliberate.
patterns: regex exemptions for whole families (real-time media, desktop shell).

known_debt: gaps that existed when this check was introduced (2026-10-16), not yet triaged. They are not deliberate, and they are listed so that new gaps stand out. Fixing one, or deciding it is deliberate, means moving it out of here.

desktop_only.get_media_url: Desktop serves media over the loopback HTTP server; mobile's equivalent is get_media_path (a file path for the native image view).
desktop_only.get_emoji_url: Desktop loopback URL; mobile's equivalent is get_emoji_path.
desktop_only.download_media: Desktop fetches into the loopback cache; mobile resolves through get_media_path.
desktop_only.download_file: Desktop saves to a picked path; mobile hands the file to the OS share sheet.
desktop_only.stage_attachment: Desktop stages drag-and-drop/pasted files before send; mobile uploads straight from the picker with upload_media.
desktop_only.upload_media_staged: Second half of desktop staging; mobile uses upload_media.
desktop_only.connect_rooms: Desktop's LiveKit room connection; mobile's data-only equivalent is get_livekit_token.
desktop_only.create_device_link: The v1 QR (#1207) is shown only by a signed-in desktop, for a new phone to scan; a signed-in phone scans the new device's v2 code instead (#1361), so it no longer shows one.
desktop_only.await_device_link: The v1 QR (#1207) is shown only by a signed-in desktop, for a new phone to scan; a signed-in phone scans the new device's v2 code instead (#1361), so it no longer shows one.
desktop_only.approve_device_link: The v1 QR (#1207) is shown only by a signed-in desktop, for a new phone to scan; a signed-in phone scans the new device's v2 code instead (#1361), so it no longer shows one.

mobile_only.version: uniffi build/version probe used by the mobile diagnostics screen; desktop reads its version from Tauri.
mobile_only.register_push_token: Push notifications are mobile-only (APNs/FCM); desktop is notified over its live connection.
mobile_only.dismissed_push_handles: Mobile push only: a phone asks which of its tray notifications were read elsewhere (#1508). Every client's reads already report through mark_conversation_read.
mobile_only.get_livekit_token: Mobile's LiveKit data-only connection; desktop's counterpart is connect_rooms.
mobile_only.bundle_export: Mobile packages export_archive output into one file for the share sheet; desktop writes the archive to a picked folder.
mobile_only.accept_device_offer: Scanning a new device's QR needs a camera, and desktop has no scanner (#1361); desktop to desktop uses the pasted v1 code.
mobile_only.finish_device_offer: Scanning a new device's QR needs a camera, and desktop has no scanner (#1361); desktop to desktop uses the pasted v1 code.
mobile_only.set_client_policy_override: Dev-build-only test override (#1611) behind the pollis://dev/client-policy link the Maestro flow drives. Desktop's Playwright scripts the mocked check instead, and the desktop and CLI take POLLIS_CLIENT_POLICY_URL from the environment.

missing_from_cli.create_device_offer: The terminal client signs in by email or Secret Key; it does not show a sign-in QR (#1361).
missing_from_cli.await_device_offer: The terminal client signs in by email or Secret Key; it does not show a sign-in QR (#1361).
missing_from_cli.cancel_device_offer: The terminal client signs in by email or Secret Key; it does not show a sign-in QR (#1361).
missing_from_cli.list_muted_channels: Per-channel mute (#1431) silences pushes and OS notifications; the terminal client raises neither and has no channel-settings surface. A mute set on desktop or mobile applies to the whole account.
missing_from_cli.set_channel_muted: Per-channel mute (#1431) silences pushes and OS notifications; the terminal client raises neither and has no channel-settings surface. A mute set on desktop or mobile applies to the whole account.
missing_from_cli.check_client_policy: The CLI runs the same check (#1611) as pollis_core::client_policy::check before it opens AppState — earlier than any command could — and exits with code 3; see pollis-tui/src/main.rs.
missing_from_cli.get_client_policy_status: The CLI reads pollis_core::client_policy::current after each action to leave the UI on a DS 426 (#1611); it does not go through the command layer.

patterns.reason: Real-time media (voice, video, screenshare) is desktop-only by product decision; mobile is LiveKit data-only (CLAUDE.md).
Desktop shell: window chrome, tray, embedded terminal, the self-updater, native file pickers and the clipboard. Mobile uses the OS share sheet and store updates instead.
